notes: The italicized 'there' is added: no source token licenses it — ἐκάθισεν's English is complete without it and rule 7's list does not reach a locative adverbial.
'six months' keeps the numeral and the noun as separate units under rule 29 even though the ASV reorders them, and the expressed καί takes its own 'and'.
τοῦ before θεοῦ is unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV writing 'of God' with no determiner, so the case preposition stays on the noun per rule 21.
